title: horminum lyratum
intro: Horminum lyratum, commonly known as Chinese Lizard Tail or Lizard Tail, is a plant species in the borage family. This plant is known for its health benefits, particularly in the treatment of various diseases, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Horminum lyratum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exert therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Horminum lyratum include reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and protecting against oxidative stress.
